relationships.subject: nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs
relationships.evidence_quote: It has been observed that the use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs affects the inflammatory process through the MyD88 molecule.

relationships.subject: MyD88-dependent pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: The most intense inflammatory process was observed in Modic type 1 degeneration, and the MyD88-dependent pathway was found to play a key role.

key_findings: TLR4/MyD88 pathway markers were highest in Modic type I and lowest in Modic type III degeneration in disc material from 88 patients.
NSAID use appeared to affect inflammation through MyD88.
